definitions.interpretation: Co-presence in the same sample is not a statistical association and not a biological interaction.
definitions.order: samples_together descending, then jaccard descending, then taxon names alphabetically.
definitions.rank: Only taxa whose recorded rank equals the requested rank are paired; rank=any pairs every taxon at whatever rank it was recorded, so a genus can pair with a species.
definitions.sample: One sample = one upload in scope (owner, upload created_at within [date_from, date_to], UTC, both days inclusive). Its contents are read from its newest stored analysis; older re-runs of the same upload are not counted. An upload with no stored analysis yet is still a sample, with no contents: rhythms places it by its timestamp with 0 detections (totals.uploads counts every sample, totals.samples_analysed those with an analysis), and co-occurrence, which can only pair taxa from analysed samples, reports uploads_in_scope for every sample and samples for the analysed ones.
definitions.samples_together: Number of samples in which both taxa are present (co-presence count).
definitions.taxon: Per sequence: results[].decision.predicted_taxon with decision.taxon_rank when the orchestrator wrote a decision, otherwise the legacy results[].predicted_taxon (rank not recorded). Sequences with contamination_flagged = true are excluded. A taxon is present in a sample when at least one remaining sequence is assigned to it.

notes: Only one sample has taxa at rank species: every pair is seen in that one sample, so the counts cannot separate taxa that tend to occur together from ones that happened to share it.
2 taxa come from results without a recorded rank (stored before the orchestrator) and are only included with rank=any.
